portal: Real Conservatorio Superior de Música de Madrid, Biblioteca
title: Quartetto Iº: per due violini, viola e violoncello obligato, fatto per servizzio di S.A.R.le D.n Luigi Ynfante di Spagna: opera 3ª
institution: Real Conservatorio Superior de Música de Madrid, Biblioteca
arrived_as_note: Supplied as a finished PDF by the library; no page-image filenames.
date_statement: Copied in Spain in 1782; the date 1775 appears on the originals. Possibly a copy of the autograph scores of 1775 (Gosálvez and Labrador).
dedication: Fatto per servizzio di S.A.R.le D.n Luigi, Infante di Spagna, da Luigi Boccherini, virtuoso di camera e compositore di musica di S.A.R.le
printed_opus_note: The title page reads "opera 3ª", Boccherini's own numbering for the set published as Op. 22. Do not read it as Op. 3.
digitized: Real Conservatorio Superior de Música de Madrid, 2007
reference: Gosálvez Lara, C. J. and Labrador López de Azcona, G., "Fuentes españolas para el estudio de la obra de L. Boccherini (1743-1805): los fondos manuscritos del Real Conservatorio de Música de Madrid", Revista de Musicología XXVII/2 (2004), pp. 743-762.
rism_catalogues_this_copy_note: RISM records no E-Mc holding anywhere in the quartet corpus; the only Madrid sigla in it are E-Mn and E-Mp. There is no RISM source record for this copy, so `rism_related` lists RISM's records for the same work at other libraries.
established_by: Identified from the library's own catalogue record (TITN 3649) and the title page: "Quartetto Iº" of the set dated 1775, which is Op. 22 no. 1 in C. The PDF's embedded title agrees. Filed 2026-10-01.
why_manual: Not linked by RISM; the library publishes the PDF directly.
note: In a note added in the 19th century: "A la Escuela Nacional de Música, Eusebio Ruiz y Rero".
rism_related_established_by: RISM lists no E-Mc holding on any of the five linked records (checked holdings: D-B, E-Mn, I-Mc, US-R, ...); the sidecar's own rism_catalogues_this_copy is false. These are RISM's records for the same work at other libraries, not this copy. [claim.py, 2026-10-01]
